auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.description: Every change to student, staff, grade, attendance and fee records — who made it, when, and what changed. Entries can't be edited or deleted.
auditLog.searchPlaceholder: Search by person or record ID
auditLog.emptyDescription: As soon as anyone adds, edits or removes a record, it will appear here.
auditLog.noMatchesHint: Try a different search or clear the filters.

validation.outOfRange: This number is out of range
validation.endBeforeStart: The end date must be after the start date
validation.yearTooLong: An academic year can't be longer than 2 years — check the dates
validation.codeFormat: Use letters, numbers and dashes only (e.g. MATH or BIO-2)

actionErrors.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
actionErrors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
actionErrors.notFound: That record no longer exists. Refresh the page and try again.
actionErrors.duplicate: Something with that name or code already exists.
actionErrors.inUse: This can't be deleted yet because it still has {reasons}. Remove or move those first.
actionErrors.inUseGeneric: This is still linked to other records, so it can't be changed or deleted.
actionErrors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

blockers.activeYear: the active-year flag (make another year active first)

academics.title: Academic setup
academics.description: Your school's years, classes, subjects and who teaches what.

years.name: Name
years.nameHint: How the year appears across EduCore.
years.setActiveDescription: Lists, dashboards and new records will use {name} by default. The current active year stays in EduCore unchanged.
years.deleteDescription: This permanently removes the year. Years that still have classes, students or records can't be deleted.
years.emptyDescription: Start by creating your current academic year — classes and students are organised inside it.
years.firstIsActive: Your first year becomes the active year automatically.

classes.name: Class name
classes.orderHint: Lower numbers appear first (e.g. 1 for the youngest class).
classes.students: {count, plural, =0 {No students} one {# student} other {# students}}
classes.deleteDescription: This removes the class, its empty sections and their teacher assignments. Classes with students or records can't be deleted.
classes.emptyDescription: Add your classes (e.g. JSS 1, JSS 2…), then add sections such as A and B to each.
classes.noYearDescription: Classes belong to an academic year.
classes.noSections: No sections yet — add one so students can be placed in this class.

sections.name: Section name
sections.deleteDescription: This removes the section and its teacher assignments. Sections with students or records can't be deleted.

subjects.name: Subject name
subjects.codeHint: A short unique code used on report cards and imports.
subjects.assignmentsCount: {count, plural, =0 {Not assigned} one {# class} other {# classes}}
subjects.deleteDescription: This removes the subject and its teacher assignments. Subjects with assessments or timetable entries can't be deleted.
subjects.emptyDescription: Add the subjects your school teaches, then assign teachers to them.

assignments.subject: Subject
assignments.deleteDescription: {teacher} will no longer be listed as teaching {subject} in {section}. No marks or records are deleted.
assignments.emptyDescription: Choose which teacher takes each subject in each class section.
assignments.prerequisites: You need at least one section, one subject and one teacher before you can assign teachers.
